summary: Re-verified the 4 regressions flagged as bugs in iteration 3. All 4 pass when using client-side navigation (sidebar link clicks). Iteration 3's failures were false positives caused by using page.goto() which triggers a full page reload and resets the in-memory React Context DataStore (seedStudents/seedBatches/seedEmployees are re-initialized). Main agent's manual assessment was correct.

action_items: No action needed for the 4 flagged regressions - all confirmed working.
Optional: previous testing agent (iteration 3) should be advised that navigating between pages of an in-memory-Context SPA must be done via client-side link clicks, not page.goto()/page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: DataStore uses in-memory React state only; a full browser refresh loses all created students/batches/employees/tasks. This is acceptable for a demo/mock app but should be documented. Consider persisting to localStorage for better UX.
nextId('STU', students.length + 124, 5) is coupled to array length: if a delete is ever added, it can produce duplicate IDs. Prefer a monotonically-increasing counter.

addWalkin/addStudent/addBatch/addEmployee/addTask useCallback deps use collection.length rather than the collection itself; combined with the length+seed trick this can cause stale closure ID collisions under rapid consecutive adds.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test entities added via UI (ZZTest86752 student, TrainerX86757 employee, BatchX86760 batch). All reset on page reload since store is in-memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When testing this app, ALWAYS use client-side navigation (click sidebar links via [data-testid="sidebar-link-*"]) between pages. NEVER use page.goto() to switch pages between create+verify steps because the DataStore is a React Context with in-memory state that resets on full page reload. Login: admin@example.com / password123.
rca of the issue: Iteration 3 false-positive RCA: The tester used await page.goto('/students') after creating a student on /registration. Because DataProvider seeds state from mockData on mount, a full page reload re-mounts the provider and discards the newly-added student, making it appear as if cross-page persistence is broken. Fix in test methodology: click sidebar-link-* elements instead of page.goto(). Verified: with proper SPA navigation, all 4 regression scenarios pass end-to-end.
